title: The Most Refreshing Drink
summary: EyeWash sponsor for an over-engineered glass of ice water. Apparatus clicks in the dark lab; the gulp lands a beat before the ice. No sung lead.
visualArc: Dark lab LEDs → window apparatus in noon sun → laminar droplets → early gulp / late ice → repeat uncorrected → hovering cube, small print.
